# Umut Oku

> .NET backend and distributed systems engineer based in Istanbul, Türkiye.

Professional work spans product/catalog APIs, Elasticsearch search and indexing, PostgreSQL query projections, Redis caching, Kafka and RabbitMQ workflows, identity services, dashboards, background processing, payment integrations and operational diagnosis. Current employment: Software Engineer at Özdisan. Earlier employers include KoçDigital and iCredible; freelance work through Fiverr. Personal projects cover microservices, Semantic Kernel, LangChain, LangGraph and RAG. These learning projects are separate from employer systems.

## Interpretation
Interactive architecture and failure scenarios use sample data. The dashboard groups courses, workshops and credentials by topic; browser diagnostics show loading measurements for the current visit. Professional work, personal projects and learning records are labelled separately.
